description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git grep' functionality within the Git project's test suite. It includes numerous test cases for various features and options of 'git grep,' such as pattern matching, context, color, threading, and handling of different input scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up and runs a test, expecting success if the commands succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with the expected output.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites like regex support or PCRE library availability.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes terminal color codes in the output for comparison.

methods.name: test_pattern_type
methods.description: Tests grep pattern matching with different pattern types.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for loop iterations.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies config variables for tests.

methods.name: test_loop
methods.description: Runs a set of tests over multiple thread counts.
